name: Plex Activity
author: s3pp3ku
description: Who's watching your Plex server right now, via your own Tautulli instance.

barWidget.description: Live Plex sessions (user, title, player, quality, progress) pulled from Tautulli.

schema.label: Tautulli URL
schema.description: Base URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8181. No trailing slash needed.

schema.label: API key
schema.description: From Tautulli Settings -> Web Interface -> API. Stored in plain text in this widget's settings, same as any other plugin key.

schema.label: Show the active-stream count next to the icon
Dim the icon when nobody is watching
